### Why Holiness Matters
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-october-26-2022.html
Passage: Leviticus 10:10
Points:
- Reading Leviticus reveals the supreme importance of God's majesty and absolute holiness.
- Although Christ's sacrifice fulfilled Old Testament rituals, God's people are still called to revere Him.
- God's instruction following the judgment of Nadab and Abihu demands clear discernment between the sacred and the ordinary.
- Believers must evaluate everyday areas—such as marriage, work, and social media—to avoid settling for what is common or impure.
- Pursuing personal holiness requires humbly asking God in prayer to guide daily thoughts, words, and actions.
